title: Suggestion: the goal first, a chat to answer it

screens.title: 1 · No goal yet
screens.why: The first suggestion is always about the goal; with nothing to make, it only talks.

pins.label: What it's about
pins.text: Objetivo · Entrega · Rotina, with the tab's icon: the order the agent looks in.

pins.label: No action
pins.text: A goal needs a number only she can say: Conversar is the one accented button.

pins.label: ✕ = Agora não
pins.text: Puts suggestions away for 24 h, as today; frees the button row.

screens.title: 2 · Goal behind, a delivery reaches it
screens.why: Goal → deliveries → routine: the delivery that adds most to the goal, with an action.

pins.label: Optional action
pins.text: Its verb and hour; makes the plan without a chat, Desfazer takes it back.

pins.label: Conversar
pins.text: Always there (and a tap on the card): the chat opens on this suggestion.

pins.label: Valid until 14:00
pins.text: Kept by the server until its hour or until goals, deliveries or routines change.

screens.title: 3 · The chat, full screen
screens.why: Opens on the agent's first message, surface and all; keyboard down to read it.

pins.label: A page, not a sheet
pins.text: Comes up from the dock; the caret takes it back down. Everywhere, not only here.

pins.label: First message
pins.text: The suggestion as the agent's opening (opening), already in the conversation.

pins.label: GenUI already there
pins.text: The delivery's peek, the plan and quick answers, as a turn draws them.

pins.label: Same plan
pins.text: Aplicar here = the card's action; Ajustar answers it.

screens.title: 4 · Answering by voice
screens.why: The words appear as heard; the round on the right sends.

pins.label: Stop = send (↑)
pins.text: Was ■ 'Parar e revisar'. One tap ends and sends.

pins.label: Trash
pins.text: The only way not to send: drop it.

screens.title: 5 · Sent at once
screens.why: No field to review: the agent answers right away, as it does today.

pins.label: Her message
pins.text: Sent as heard, the moment the recording stopped.

pins.label: por voz · 0:06
pins.text: Marked as spoken, as held-and-released already was.
